markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (84%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Reliability flag raised; second model and similar cases disagree [F6].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 84%, InSitu 10%, Benign 5% | Clear lead, wider set |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90%) | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.67 / 84th percentile | Flagged; input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 0 of 5 Invasive; 5 InSitu | Neighbors point elsewhere |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with less invasive disease [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Slightly above typical; small positive term · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Near-typical score; adds little here · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Above typical, but spot check failed (0/20) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 4) · context · Below-typical score; descriptive only [F2] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Image quality is suspect (reliability 0.67, 84th-percentile OOD); probabilities may not transfer.
- Second model disagrees and all five neighbors are InSitu; true class may be InSitu.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9** — highest-risk regions (>99%); confirm invasive growth versus in situ.
2. **Regions 10, 11** — tubule-rich with high heatmap contribution; assess gland architecture directly.
3. **Region 4** — stroma-infiltration signal; look for tumor cells in stroma.
